Keyed by word id, not by position: the corpus is re-ordered whenever difficulty is re-scored, and an index would silently attach every meaning to the wrong word. Each row is [meaning, example translation]. Translated from the canonical taught sense — the English gloss and the Korean example together — not from the Korean word alone, so a polysemous headword cannot drift to another sense in one language.
